title: Progress & Strategy Report — The Per-Step Inference Predictor, End to End
summary_zh: 面向指導教授的非侵入式逐步推論時間預測器收尾報告。重述模型：$t_{step}$ 方程式、五因子計算天花板，以及 H100 989-TFLOP 算式（132 SM × 4 tensor core × 512 FMA × 2 × 1.83 GHz）。展示六張真實 GPU 的逐-SKU 因子曲線——時脈為 30 點下拉、cap→clock→throughput 因果鏈與 clock-lock 控制（114.8→99.5 TFLOP/s）、逐-SKU 下垂（A100 20.2%、H100 30.3%、H200 26.5%、L40S 43.5%、Blackwell 54.4%）。每個 headline 數字皆溯源結果檔：跨-GPU 遷移勝利（未見 H100 OURS 7.3% vs spec-scaled RF 11.4%，1.56×）、度量發散教訓（擬合 Vidur GT 把 prefill 改善到 14.8% 卻讓真實 ShareGPT wall-clock decode 由 6.8% 惡化到 12.9%）、L2 reuse 律（4.59% MAPE、3 SKU）、SKU 選擇 92.3%、power-aware +10.5%、Sarathi +30.7%、QLM 混合。最後附下一步反思與投稿方向地圖：三篇候選論文（A 頻率量測筆記 cold 7.0、B 預測器 cold 6.5、C 服務效用）各自的成熟度、缺口與會場。進行中項目（E1.14 部分、E2.10 排隊）誠實標註，未杜撰。
summary_en: An advisor-facing closing report on the non-intrusive per-step inference-time predictor. Restates the model: the $t_{step}$ equation, the five-factor compute ceiling, and the H100 989-TFLOP arithmetic (132 SMs × 4 tensor cores × 512 FMA × 2 × 1.83 GHz). Shows per-SKU factor curves on six real GPUs — the clock factor as a 30-point pull-down, the cap→clock→throughput causal chain with a clock-lock control (114.8→99.5 TFLOP/s), and per-SKU droop (20.2% A100, 30.3% H100, 26.5% H200, 43.5% L40S, 54.4% Blackwell). Every headline number is traced to a results file: the cross-GPU transfer win (OURS 7.3% vs spec-scaled RF 11.4% on unseen H100, 1.56×), the metric-divergence lesson (fitting Vidur's GT improves prefill to 14.8% but makes real ShareGPT wall-clock decode worse, 6.8→12.9%), the L2 reuse law (4.59% MAPE, 3 SKUs), SKU selection 92.3%, power-aware +10.5%, Sarathi +30.7%, QLM mixed. Closes with a next-steps reflection and a submission-directions map: three candidate papers (A frequency measurement note, cold 7.0; B the predictor, cold 6.5; C the serving utility) with each one's maturity, remaining gaps, and target venue. In-flight items (E1.14 partial, E2.10 queued) marked honestly, not invented.
